title: ci: run the boat jobs on instabox
body:
Moves test.yml's self-hosted jobs from boat to the instabox GitHub App:

- Types and lint, and the portable quick-test shards: `boat-large` → `instabox-large` (8 vCPU / 16 GiB)
- package (Node 20 and 24): `boat` → `instabox-medium` (4 vCPU / 8 GiB)

Each job gets a fresh box of GitHub's Ubuntu 24.04 runner image, deleted when the job ends. The native shards stay on GitHub's `ubuntu-24.04`, and publish.yml's publish job stays on GitHub's runner (npm trusted publishing needs a cloud-hosted one). The same-repository guard on every instabox job is unchanged, so fork PRs never reach a box. The other changes are comments.

title: build: supercomputer on instabox only
body:
Moves gdp-wired's jobs to the TypeScript supercomputer (monotykamary/supercomputer#instabox-ts), which runs only on instabox.

- `supercomputer.toml`: the instabox image (template `ci`, `supercomputer/setup.sh`, snapshot `sc-gdp-wired-d8f6b3e6f661`, size `large`), path, env, ignore, the `runner` image and the olean cache.
- `supercomputer/setup.sh` replaces `hooks.py`.
- Removed: the Python supercomputer files, the `modal` link, `gates/boat-pass.py` and the Modal harnesses. `gates/bar.ts` runs its jobs with `supercomputer run`.
- Jobs files keep only what instabox honours.

Checked on instabox: `bun run check` is clean, and smoke plus fuzz pass 36/36 in 1m43s on 5 boxes. Native test shards 1 and 2 pass. Shard 3 has 19 C Safety failures under UBSan, which also fail on `main` on the same snapshot, so they come from the box environment, not this change.

**Not done yet: the npm publish gate.** `publish.yml`'s `full-gate` job wants a receipt made by `scripts/release-ci/full-gate-runner.ts`. That script calls `supercomputer run --backend boat --class ...`, which the new supercomputer refuses. Until the gate is ported to instabox, no release can publish. Don't merge before that's in.
